title: Forward useCRUD mutationError from the audio-scene and AI-testing hooks
body:
## Summary
useAudioScene and useAITesting discard the failure reason useCRUD exposes, so a failed create, update or delete returns null with no reason.

## Description
useCRUD documents mutationError as existing so callers can surface a failure (src/hooks/useCRUD.ts:28). src/hooks/useAudioScene.ts:59 and src/hooks/useAITesting.ts:54 destructure only data, isLoading, error, refetch and mutate. Only ZoneGeneratorPanel consumes mutationError today. Fixed means both hooks return it and the views show it.

## Flow
- Delete a suite while the server fails
- mutate logs and returns null
- AIBehaviorView has no reason to show

## Expected impact
Designers see why a scene or suite write failed. Risk: the banner placement touches two views outside this context.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - failed writes state their reason
Before: 2 hooks, 14 mutating operations, 0 forward the reason
After: 2 hooks forward it, views render it (not built)
Method: simulation - the fix needs view changes outside this context
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Component test on AudioView and AIBehaviorView: failing DELETE renders the server reason

title: PoF bridge keeps the old endpoint when host or port changes while connected
body:
## Summary
The autoDetect effect re-runs on a host or port change but connects only from disconnected, so a connected session stays on the old endpoint while manifest URLs use the new port.

## Description
src/hooks/usePofBridge.ts:78 reads status and skips connect unless disconnected. useManifest and useSnapshots build URLs from the store port (src/hooks/useManifest.ts:68, src/hooks/useSnapshots.ts:51), so the two disagree until something drops the connection. Fixed means an endpoint change reconnects, or the settings surface says a reconnect is required.

## Flow
- Connect on port A
- Change the PoF port in Bridge Doctor
- Connection stays on A while manifest requests go to B

## Expected impact
Operators with two editors stop reading one editor while connected to another. Risk: reconnecting on every keystroke of a port field needs a debounce.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - one endpoint at a time
Before: connected + port change: 0 reconnects, 2 hooks on the new port
After: 1 reconnect, all on the new port (not built)
Method: simulation - code walk; needs a decision on keystroke behaviour in the settings fields
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Hook test: connected state + store port change asserts connect called with the new port once

title: A wheel zoom during a drag snaps the canvas on the next pointer move
body:
## Summary
useCanvasTransform pans from an origin captured at drag start, so a zoom during the drag is overwritten by the stale origin.

## Description
src/hooks/useCanvasTransform.ts:50 sets panX and panY from panOrigin plus the delta, while onWheel changes pan at src/hooks/useCanvasTransform.ts:71 without moving panOrigin or panStart. Fixed means the wheel rebases the drag.

## Flow
- Press and drag the plan map
- Scroll the wheel without releasing
- Move the pointer: the view jumps to the pre-zoom pan

## Expected impact
Removes a visible jump on the plan map. Risk: low, one hook and one consumer.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - no jump on zoom during pan
Before: walked: pan after wheel-then-move ignores the wheel adjustment
After: pan continues from the zoomed position (not built)
Method: simulation - not measured this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Hook test: startPan, wheel, move; assert pan equals the zoomed pan plus the move delta

title: useCollectionEditor has no test and loses edits made in one tick
body:
## Summary
The ability editors share a hook with zero tests whose operations each spread the items from their own render.

## Description
src/hooks/useCollectionEditor.ts:12 to src/hooks/useCollectionEditor.ts:24 compute from the captured items, so two calls before a re-render lose the first. It has 3 consumers and no test file references it. Fixed means a characterisation test, plus a decision on whether any consumer batches.

## Flow
- Call add then update in one handler
- The second onChange is built from the old items
- The first change is lost

## Expected impact
Pins a shared editor primitive. Risk: test-only unless a batching consumer is found.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - shared primitive covered
Before: 0 tests, 3 consumers
After: operations pinned (not built)
Method: simulation - no consumer batching was confirmed
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
src/hooks/useCollectionEditor.ts:12
grep of src/__tests__ for useCollectionEditor: 0 files
instrument: Hook test of add, remove, update and a same-tick pair

title: usePofBridge returns four fields no caller reads
body:
## Summary
connect, disconnect, status and pluginInfo on usePofBridge have no consumer among its three call sites.

## Description
Call sites: src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx:57 and src/components/layout-lab/NewHome.tsx:19 ignore the result, and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/loot-filter/ExportPanel.tsx:41 reads isConnected. Per-hook local state exists only to serve those fields (src/hooks/usePofBridge.ts:35). Fixed means dropping the unused surface, or keeping it on purpose with a consumer.

## Flow
- Grep usePofBridge() across src/components
- 3 call sites, 1 field read

## Expected impact
A smaller hook and one fewer copy of connection state. Risk: tests that mock its return shape.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - less unused surface
Before: 5 returned fields, 1 read
After: fields reduced to those read (not built)
Method: probe - the consumer grep was taken; removal was not tried because mocks in 4 test files need review
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Remove the fields, run typecheck and the 4 importing test files

title: A superseded snapshot capture clears the busy flag of the newer one
body:
## Summary
When a capture supersedes another, the first settles with an error and its conclude sets isCapturing false while the second still runs.

## Description
src/hooks/useSnapshots.ts:120 settles the previous readback, and src/hooks/useSnapshots.ts:148 clears isCapturing for it. The tab buttons disable on isCapturing, so this needs a programmatic capture path such as a suite run from useTestHarnessPanel. Fixed means only the latest capture owns the flag and error.

## Flow
- Start a capture
- Start another before the first report arrives
- First settles superseded: error shown, isCapturing false during the second

## Expected impact
The panel stops reporting a false failure and idle state. Risk: low, one hook.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - busy state matches the live capture
Before: walked: isCapturing false with one capture still running
After: true until the latest settles (not built)
Method: simulation - whether a programmatic path overlaps was not confirmed
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Hook test: two captures, first superseded; assert isCapturing stays true and error stays null
